java_decimal.dart adapts the binary-to-decimal conversion algorithm in
OpenJDK 8 sun.misc.FloatingDecimal, Copyright (c) 1996, 2013 Oracle and/or
its affiliates. The original file's license header is retained. The file is
licensed under GPL version 2 only with the Classpath exception. See LICENSE
in this directory. The Classpath exception is retained for this adaptation.

Upstream source:
https://github.com/openjdk/jdk8u/blob/master/jdk/src/share/classes/sun/misc/FloatingDecimal.java

Changes: implementation language changed to Dart; FDBigInteger replaced with
Dart BigInt; only binary-to-decimal formatting retained; Java fixed-width
overflow, rounding and integer fast-path behavior retained for compatibility.

java_unicode_data.dart is generated Unicode property data exported by the
included JavaUnicodeOracle.java, not Java implementation source.
